personality: A towering Red Waste raider turned Keeper who hits first and hits hardest. Loud, warm and blunt; treats every fight like a contest he fully intends to win. Joined the Keepers after they pulled his raiding band out of a goblin warren; he pays his debts in blood and laughter.
inAFight: Close fast and swing before enemies act (Ambush Strike), Rage on your first swing, Whirlwind the hobgoblin guards, and when the troll drops, oil it or torch it.
abilitiesText:
**Rage.** As part of an attack or your move, rage for up to 6 rounds, 4 times per day. While raging: +2 melee weapon damage. Ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

**Extra Attack (7th).** When you take the attack action, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage.

**Whirlwind Attack (4th).** Once per encounter, instead of your normal attacks: one attack roll against each of up to 3 opponents within 5ft whose Level is 4 or lower. You cannot have retreated before using it. Hobgoblin guards (Level 1) and captains (Level 3) qualify; the warlord (8) and troll (10) do not.

**Intimidate (Strength).** Uses your action. One creature of Level 9 or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 17) or has Disadvantage on attack rolls for 1d4 rounds. Each creature can be targeted once per encounter.

**Primeval Will (6th).** Once per day, when your HP drops to 18 or less, gain 18 bonus HP (lost first, gone when combat ends). Triggers automatically if you drop to 0 or below; if that leaves you at 1+ HP you keep fighting. Cannot stop a blow that kills you outright.

**Combat Sense.** +2 to surprise checks. Attackers get no Advantage on you from flanking or being Unseen, and Back Attack style bonuses do not work on you.

**Thick Hide.** +2 AC in no armour or light armour (already in your AC).

**Primeval Instincts.** In light or no armour, once per round, +4 to a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution check in extreme circumstances (breaking free, holding a door, leaping a hazard). Also: hold breath twice as long, climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

**Kit: Ambush Strike.** Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a target that has not yet acted in this combat.

**Kit: Desert Born.** Advantage on Survival in arid or desert terrain, and on identifying Red Waste tribal markings or customs.

**Large.** 10ft x 10ft space, +5ft melee reach, ignore the Heavy weapon Disadvantage. Disadvantage on Stealth and on squeezing through tight spaces.

**Mountain Endurance.** Once per long rest, when hit, reduce the damage by 1d12+3 (spend 1 Luck for another use). Advantage on Fortitude saves against exhaustion, forced marching and thin air.

**Giant-kin strength.** Advantage on Strength checks to push, drag, lift or break against a smaller creature or object.

**Resistance to cold.** Resistance 5 to cold damage.

**Darkvision.** 60ft.

**Jotunas Goliath.** Advantage on Jotunas terrain, tribal-custom and true-giant-lineage checks, and on Charisma checks towards Dul Khagul dwarves.

**Weapon training.** Two-handed axe, maul, javelin, greatclub (Barbarians already use any weapon).

**Toughness (1st, General).** +1 Max HP per level (+9, included), +1 Constitution (included), Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Critical Strike (2nd, Martial).** Your weapon attacks crit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits. A crit adds the maximum of the weapon dice.

**Armour Master (6th, Martial).** +1 AC while wearing armour (included).

**Speed, initiative and HP.** Speed: 30ft (Large: 10ft x 10ft space, 10ft melee reach) · Initiative: +1 · HP: Level 1: d12 max 12 + Con +3 = 15. Levels 2-9: 8 x (7 + 3) = 80. Toughness: +1 x 9 levels = 9. Total 104.

personality: A Jinia Isles boarding-duellist who turns every swing at her into a mistake. Teasing, theatrical and quick to apologise to the foe she has just embarrassed. Joined the Keepers for a steady fee and a good story; stayed because they are the only crew she trusts at her back.
inAFight: Engage one hobgoblin at a time, attack with rapier and main gauche every round, and save your out-of-turn Flourish to Parry the biggest hit (or Riposte a miss).
abilitiesText:
**Flourish Manoeuvres.** Once per round, out of turn, use ONE of: Parry (when hit in melee, d20 + 3 Dex + 2 Serpent's Guard; meet or beat the attack roll and the hit is negated); Riposte (when a melee attack misses you, make a free attack at the attacker); Acrobatic Escape (9th; when hit, d20 + 3 Dex vs the attack roll: halve the damage and move 10ft without provoking). No Parry in medium/heavy armour or with a shield.

**Extra Attack (7th).** When you take the attack action, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage.

**Disarming Strike (7th).** On a hit, deal no damage and instead force a Fortitude save (DC 17) or the target drops what it holds. Counts as your attack for that round.

**Opening Flourish.** First attack of the combat adds +3 (Cha) damage. Once per encounter.

**Finesse.** Dex to attack and damage with rapier, dagger, main gauche and short sword.

**Agile Defence.** +2 AC in light or no armour with no shield (included).

**Light Feet (4th).** Creatures you attacked this turn cannot make Attacks of Opportunity as you move away.

**En Garde (5th).** Advantage on initiative rolls.

**Kit: Serpent's Guard.** +2 to Parry checks (included above).

**Kit: Read the Blade.** Advantage on Acrobatics on moving surfaces (decks, rooftops, rope bridges) and on Insight to read a foe's fighting style mid-combat.

**Dual Heritage.** Once per long rest, reroll one failed save or check (1 Luck for a second use).

**Sleep and charm.** Immune to magical sleep; Advantage on saves against charm.

**Social ease.** Advantage on social checks with humans and elves.

**Chosen skill.** Advantage on Deception (Charisma) checks.

**Flexible Rest.** Fully rested after a 4-hour trance or 8-hour sleep.

**Low-Light Vision.** Dim light counts as bright; light sources reach twice as far for you. No sight in total darkness.

**Weapon and armour training.** Longsword, short sword, longbow, plus Bow, Long Composite (chosen martial weapon); light armour.

**Swift Reflexes (1st, General).** Advantage on initiative, +1 Dexterity (included: Dex 18, the creation cap).

**Two-Weapon Fighting (2nd, Martial/Specialist).** Your off-hand attack has no Disadvantage.

**Toughness (6th, General).** +1 Max HP per level (+9, included), +1 Constitution (included), Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Speed, initiative and HP.** Speed: 30ft · Initiative: +3 with Advantage (En Garde, Swift Reflexes) · HP: Level 1: d8 max 8 + Con +1 = 9. Levels 2-9: 8 x (5 + 1) = 48. Toughness: +1 x 9 levels = 9. Total 66.

spells.notes:
Every spell is resolved by the target's save against your DC. Tick a slot box when you cast; slots return after a full rest. Cantrips are cast at will. Prepare 12 spells each morning from the Cleric list (9 level + 3 Wis); cantrips are extra. Slots include the Wisdom bonus slots. Healer feat: healing spells restore +1 HP per die (included); once per day, cast one healing spell of 3rd level or lower without using a slot.

Cantrips: Sacred Flame (60ft, one creature: 2d4 radiant, Reflex DC 17 negates; cover gives no help). Toll the Dead (60ft, one creature: 2d4 necrotic, 2d6 if it is already hurt, Will DC 17 negates). First Aid (touch: a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP, no roll; restores no HP). Light (touch an object: bright light 20ft + dim 20ft for 9 hours). Detect Magic (self, 60ft cone, 9 rounds: see which creatures/objects carry magic and the strongest school; ritual).

1st: Cure Light Wounds (touch: heals 1d8+6 HP, 1d8+5 +1 from Healer). Bless (50ft, up to 6 allies, 1 minute: Advantage on the first attack roll each round and +1 to saves; reverse (Bane) on 6 enemies, Will negates). Command (30ft, one creature that understands you: Approach, Drop, Flee or Halt on its next turn; Will DC 17 negates; mindless immune). Guiding Bolt (120ft, one creature: 3d8 radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves; next attack on it before your next turn ends has Advantage, a save negates that).

2nd: Aid (touch, 9 minutes: Advantage on first attack each round, +1 to saves, 1d8 temporary HP; does not stack with Bless). Hold Person (120ft, one humanoid, hobgoblins count: Paralysed for 9 rounds, repeats the save each turn; Will DC 17 negates). Spiritual Weapon (60ft, 9 rounds: a spectral weapon automatically hits one creature within 5ft of it each of your turns for 1d6+3 force; move it 30ft a round; AC 15, 10 HP).

3rd: Cure Serious Wounds (touch: heals 2d8+11 HP, 2d8+9 +2 from Healer). Prayer (40ft radius on you, 9 rounds: allies get Advantage on first attack each round and +1 damage and saves; enemies get Disadvantage on first attack and -1 damage and saves; no save). Spirit Guardians (self, 15ft radius, moves with you, 9 rounds: enemies there move at half speed and take 1d6 radiant, or necrotic chosen when cast, once per round when they enter or start their turn there; Will DC 17 halves).

4th: Healing Circle (range 30ft, 20ft burst: every living creature in it heals 1d8+10 HP, 1d8+9 +1 from Healer; careful: heals enemies in the burst too).

5th: Flame Strike (60ft, 10ft-radius 40ft-high cylinder: 9d6, half fire and half radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves; the fire half stops the troll regenerating).

personality: A radiant dawn-priest who keeps the Keepers standing and the dark at bay. Patient, sunny and quietly stubborn; believes every bad night ends in a morning. Joined the Keepers because Burrow's Den needed a healer who would walk into the dark with them, not wait at the gate.
inAFight: Open with Bless or Prayer, keep allies up with Cure spells and Healing Circle, Hold Person a hobgoblin, and save Flame Strike for the troll.
abilitiesText:
**Spell Use.** Divine caster, Wisdom. Spell DC 17. Prepare 12 spells each morning from the Cleric list (9 level + 3 Wis); cantrips are extra. Slots below include the Wisdom bonus slots.

**Turn Undead.** Action, 6 times per day: every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you makes a Will save (DC 17). Fail: destroyed if its Level is 4 or lower, otherwise turned (flees, cannot come within 30ft for 1 minute).

**Granted Power: Dawning Light.** Advantage on your first attack roll each round against undead. Once per day: a 20ft burst of dawn light; undead in it make a Will save or flee for 1 minute.

**Weapon Selection.** Cleric weapon list plus Lathander's favoured weapon, the heavy mace.

**Resistance to necrotic and radiant.** Resistance 5 to necrotic and radiant damage.

**Lay on Hands.** Once per long rest, heal a creature 9 HP (your level).

**Inner light.** Once per long rest, shed bright light in a 10ft radius (illumination only).

**Fearless.** Advantage on saves against being Frightened.

**Chosen skill.** Advantage on First Aid/Healing checks (combined with your NWP).

**Darkvision.** 60ft.

**War Caster (1st, Arcane & Devout).** Cast somatic spells with mace and shield in hand. Advantage on Fortitude saves to keep a spell when damaged.

**Healer (4th, Arcane & Devout).** Healing spells restore +1 HP per die (included in the spell lines). Once per day, cast one healing spell of 3rd level or lower without using a slot.

**Toughness (8th, General).** +1 Max HP per level (+9, included), +1 Constitution (included: Con 16), Advantage on Constitution checks.

personality: An ex-watch marksman who stands still, shoots straight and pins runners in place. Dry, procedural and unflappable; reads every room like a crime scene. Left the Watch when the paperwork outgrew the policing; the Keepers let her actually stop the bad thing.
inAFight: Stand still and shoot: your first shot each round has Advantage and +1d6, it reloads itself, and one hit a round can be a Leg shot to slow the troll.
abilitiesText:
**Dead Eye.** Advantage on your first ranged attack each round if you do not move this turn (you stay rooted after shooting). Forced movement does not count.

**Steady Shot (5th).** While Dead Eye applies, your first hit each round deals +1d6.

**Extra Attack (7th).** When you take the attack action, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage. Each shot needs a loaded firearm.

**Lightning Reload (9th).** Pistols reload as part of the attack that fired them, once per round.

**Quick Draw.** Drawing a loaded pistol does not use your free object use.

**Firearm Proficiency.** Firearms without Disadvantage; damage dice explode (a die showing its maximum is rolled again and added).

**Called Shot (4th).** Declare before rolling; the shot has Disadvantage; one per round; saves DC 17. Head: Fortitude or Stunned 1 round (then immune 1 minute). Arm: Fortitude or drops what it holds. Leg: Fortitude or speed halved 1 round.

**Kit: Precision Placement.** Once per round, after any hit, make it a Leg shot with no declaration and no Disadvantage (Fortitude DC 17 or speed halved for 1 round).

**Brace and Fire (9th).** Once per round, out of turn, when a creature charges you: shoot before it reaches you (Dead Eye not required). On a hit it takes damage and makes a Fortitude save (DC 17) or its charge stops.

**Trick Shot (7th).** Dex check vs a GM-set DC for an impossible shot: around corners, ricochets, disarm within 30ft, cut a rope. One try per round; failure just misses.

**Grit.** Once per day, when dropped to 0 HP or below, make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + damage taken below 0). Success: stay at 1 HP and conscious.

**Kit: Badge and Barrel.** Advantage on identifying criminals by description, navigating Opal's legal system, and acting as a witness or enforcer of Opal law.

**Attribute bonus.** +1 Dex and +1 Con (included).

**Bonus feat.** An extra General feat at 1st level (Swift Reflexes).

**Chosen skill.** Advantage on Perception (Wisdom checks to notice things).

**Weapon and armour training.** Two martial weapons: Sword, Long and Bow, Long. Light and medium armour.

**Swift Reflexes (Human bonus, General).** Advantage on initiative, +1 Dexterity (included: Dex 18, the creation cap).

**Steady Aim (1st, Specialist).** No Disadvantage on ranged attacks against a target in melee with an ally.

**Point-Blank Terror (2nd, Specialist).** No Disadvantage on ranged attacks while an enemy is within 5ft of you.

**Critical Strike (6th, Martial).** Weapon attacks crit on a natural 20, or a natural 19 that hits. A crit adds the maximum of the weapon dice (12 for a pistol).

**Speed, initiative and HP.** Speed: 30ft · Initiative: +3 with Advantage (Swift Reflexes) · HP: Level 1: d8 max 8 + Con +2 = 10. Levels 2-9: 8 x (5 + 2) = 56. Total 66.

**Kit: Crushing Blow.** Reroll 1s and 2s on two-handed weapon damage dice.

**Kit: Breaker.** Advantage on Strength checks to break, smash or force objects.

**Relentless Endurance.** Once per day, when damage would drop you to 0 HP or below, drop to 1 HP instead.

**Onslaught.** Once per long rest, spend 1 Luck to make one more weapon attack, as part of the same action, against a creature you just damaged.

**Brutal Strikes.** On a critical hit, add one extra damage die of the weapon's type.

**Chosen skill.** Advantage on Intimidation (Charisma) checks.

**Toughness (3rd, General).** +1 Max HP per level (+9, included), +1 Constitution (included), Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Armour Master (6th, Martial).** +1 AC while wearing armour (included).
